easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cast Volatile Claws by paying {2}{R}, causing creatures you control, including HYDRA Assault Robot, to get +2/+0 and gain all creature types until end of turn, including Pirate.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Hydra Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers at least once.
Resolve a Hydra Assault Robot trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 4.
